2.translation: and by the night when it covers with darkness[1],

3.translation: your Lord has neither forsaken you [O Prophet] nor hated you;

4.translation: the Hereafter is better for you than the present life;

5.translation: and your Lord will certainly give you so much that you will be well pleased.

6.translation: Did He not find you an orphan then take good care of you?

7.translation: Did He not find you unguided then guide you?

8.translation: Did He not find you in need then enrich you?

9.translation: So do not mistreat the orphan,

10.footnotes: [2] i.e., anyone in need who seeks help.

11.translation: and proclaim the favors of your Lord[3].
11.footnotes: [3] i.e., be grateful to Allah by proclaiming the favors He has given you.
